brief.zh: 向僵尸发射穿透且使之减速的光束

description.en: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire piercing shadowy peas at zombies.
description.zh: 暗影豌豆属于暗影植物，得到暗影强化时能穿透整行僵尸。

chat.en: "Phoot, " Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in the evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
chat.zh: “噗。”暗影豌豆说着，朝远处的僵尸射出了一枚暗影般的……呃……嗯……大概可以称之为豌豆的东西吧。“呃啊！”那僵尸显然吃了一惊，倒吸一口气。此时，暗流在这两者之间涌动。

text.en: fires piercing, slowing bolts when powered
text.zh: 暗影状态下，发射穿透的、减速效果的电光

text.en: hides and swallows zombies that approach
text.zh: 能隐蔽自身并吞噬靠近的僵尸
